description: Posts a clip made by cut_clip to the user's YouTube channel (as a Short) or TikTok, with their caption, so find moment -> cut -> post happens without leaving the chat. Needs the account code from cut_clip. The user connects YouTube or TikTok once: until then this returns needs_connect and a connect link, and the same call works once they have connected. YouTube may still keep a new app's uploads private until YouTube finishes its own review, and TikTok posts stay private until TikTok finishes reviewing. The result says so and how to publish it.

caption.description: The caption, in the user's words. YouTube: it becomes the description, and its first line the title unless title is given.

privacy.description: Who can see it (default public; the platform may force private, see the result)

tiktok_mode.description: TikTok only: direct = post it (default); draft = send to the user's TikTok inbox to finish in the app

title.description: YouTube only: the Short's title, up to 100 characters

name: post_clip
title: Post a clip to YouTube Shorts or TikTok with a caption
